channel.description: Latest articles from Worcester Business Journal (wbjournal.com)

item.title: Cannabis regulators weighing licensing freeze
item.description: Massachusetts cannabis regulators are considering a licensing freeze to address businesses that have been squeezed by falling marijuana prices. The Cannabis Control Commission voted Thursday to schedule a public hearing […]

item.title: Fitchburg economic development to receive boost from state
item.description: Fitchburg’s participation in the program will see part of the municipality designated as a TDI district, providing access to MassDevelopment employees with economic development expertise.

item.title: Ameresco completes 6MW Rhode Island landfill solar project
item.description: The new array is expected to provide $4.4 million in economic benefits to the Town of Coventry during the initial lease period.

item.title: Worcester picks Rhode Island official as new health commissioner
item.description: Following the retirement of Worcester’s long-time Health and Human Services Commissioner Dr. Matilde Castiel, the City has named Seema Dixit as her successor.

item.title: Conversion of former Fallon HQ to housing receives $3.6M tax credit
item.description: Launched through 2024's $5 billion housing policy and borrowing law, the initiative is designed to support projects that turn underused or vacant office buildings into new housing units.

item.title: Health and environmental groups sue EPA over emissions rule
item.description: A coalition of health and environmental groups has sued the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, challenging its decision last week to rescind a 2009 finding that has served a the basis for regulating […]

item.title: Central Mass. home sales slow to start 2026
item.description: Central Massachusetts saw a slower-than-usual start to the 2026 single-family real estate season.

item.title: Worcester-Boston worker compensation costs up 3.6%, slightly above national rate
item.description: Increases in wages and salaries should help workers dealing with increasing costs of living.

item.title: 🔒 American Eagle Outfitters to close Devens fulfillment center, lay off 100+ employees
item.description: AE Regional Distribution Co., a subsidiary of apparel company American Eagle Outfitters, is closing its Devens fulfillment facility, laying off 103 employees in the process.

item.title: 🔒 Saint Vincent Hospital found to have violated 14 labor practices
item.description: A judge has determined the Worcester hospital infringed 14 labor practices between February 2022 and September 2023.
